furniture_removal.reason: The room is completely empty with no furniture remnants, ghost outlines, or phantom shadows visible

style_commitment.reason: This is an empty room with painted walls, not a COVAMINIMAL design; there is zero style execution, no furniture, no minimal aesthetic vocabulary—it's simply an unfurnished space

editorial_density.reason: Completely barren room with no furniture, no art, no textiles, no plants, no lighting fixtures, no styling whatsoever—the opposite of Architectural Digest editorial staging

photorealism.reason: The render has realistic lighting and materials on existing surfaces, but the arched window transformation appears artificial and the window view doesn't integrate naturally with the modified architecture

designer_preference_reason: Collov delivers a fully realized, editorial-quality staged room with cohesive design while Cova produces an empty, unstaged space that destroys the original architecture.
